description: React component for a resizable divider used in a sidebar, allowing users to resize UI panels with drag-and-drop and double-click functionality.

classes.name: ResizableDivider
classes.description: React functional component implementing a draggable and double-clickable resizable divider with styled-components styling.

methods.name: defaultOnResizeChange
methods.description: Updates CSS variable for container width and stores last width.

methods.name: handleOnResize
methods.description: Calls external onResize callback and updates CSS variable.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets internal refs related to resize state.

methods.name: onMouseDown
methods.description: Initiates resize operation on mouse down event.

methods.name: onDoubleClick
methods.description: Handles double-click to reset or toggle resize state.
